description: A large rectilinear enclosure dated from the 5th BCE to the beginning of the 3rd CE when it appears to have been abandoned. Several curvilinear structures at the centre of the enclosure, suggested to be a religious or ceremonial site, seemingly due to lack of any other evidence. The RSRB marks it as a 'shrine'.
bibliography: Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Normanton Golf Course, Normanton (West Yorkshire).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
